hostname ix-y01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.10
ip route 192.0.2.0/25 Tunnel0.0
!
ikev2 authentication psk id fqdn rt-y01.example.com key char dummy-psk-site-y01
ikev2 authentication psk id fqdn ix-y02.example.com key char dummy-psk-site-y02
!
ikev2 profile ikev2-0
  child-lifetime 3600
  child-pfs 2048-bit
  child-proposal enc aes-cbc-256
  child-proposal integrity sha1
  dpd interval 30
  local-authentication psk id fqdn rt-y01.example.com
  nat-traversal
  retransmit count 3 interval 5
  sa-lifetime 43200
  sa-proposal dh 2048-bit
  sa-proposal enc aes-cbc-256
  sa-proposal integrity sha2-256
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  description sample vpn
  ip address 192.0.2.209/30
  tunnel mode ipsec-ikev2
  ikev2 binding ikev2-0
  ikev2 peer 203.0.113.20 authentication psk id fqdn ix-y02.example.com
  ikev2 source-address GigaEthernet0.0
  no shutdown
!
